reviews.text:
Please could you update your opening days on both Google business and your own booking platform?

We’ve just travelled far for a booked appointment but your practice is closed on Saturdays.

🫤

There have been many changes at this vet surgery in the past couple of years. The vet we saw was caring and thorough, easy to talk to. We were only in for a checkup but I felt that if there was a problem it would have been easy to discuss m.
Medivet Parsons Green and Stelios look after my lovely dog DC as if she were their own. Could not ask for better, more attentive care.
The best
The kindness and professionalism we received was outstanding. Big thank you to the Medivet Barns Stuff

If there’s anything I’ve learnt owning a dog in London is that not all Medivet’s are created equal. Was left waiting for ages and had to leave before being seen on my first appointment - was told vet often overruns so not just a one off.. (btw don’t mind when things are late if told etc). I suggest going to Barnes Medivet if you can - on time, great vets and also a cool vet shop for bits.
Great people and services. Fantastic staff

We are very grateful to Medivet Parsons Green for their attentive and professional care. The staff are friendly, compassionate, and take the time to explain everything clearly.

Our pet felt as comfortable as possible during what could have been a stressful experience, which really shows how much the team genuinely cares about animals.

The clinic is clean, well-organised, and appointments run smoothly. Thank you to the whole team for your kindness and support.

We would highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a reliable and caring veterinary practice.

They have increased their prices for dog dental clean by over 100% in 3 years. This kind of multinational corporation priorities profits over care. Read the other reviews if in doubt. Independent places over better value,  care and pricing.
Very happy

We love Parsons Green Medivet. The staff are so friendly, efficient and really helpful, especially Lynn and Bibi. We met Stelios the vet this morning for a health check for our dog. He was very gentle with Bailey. I highly recommend this veterinary practice. The practice has just had a make over, which looks bright and clean. The little logos are brilliant! Thank you all so much. You are a great team. ♥️🐶⭐️
Very good, very friendly and I feel my dog is in very safe hands
Brilliant vet. Friendly, knowledgeable and caring. First vet where my dog didn’t shake from nervousness!
Always great to deal with, they genuinely care about the furry ones
Dr Valentina was very professional, caring and joy to deal with.
My cat had a health problem and she was seen the same day. The problem has been resolved.
Great service and very friendly for our little Benji

If I could give this vet a -100000000 score I would. Our dear dog of nearly 14 years, who had been here since we moved from Canada (10years), was denied proper end of life care.

I was denied help, and was told to wait over 48 hours to have her put down.  A chronic condition the vet knew about, and she was in so much pain. I had to find another vet to put her down

I’m writing this now as I keep getting emails about having our dog come in. How uncaring and irresponsible.

** reply —— contact you for what purpose? My dog is dead and you refused her proper end of life care. I’m super happy at pickles who actually cares. Terrible experience and I’m warning others as end of life is just as important as during life - if not more. I’d never call for your benefit. I hope this is a lesson and is managed

Great vets, great service, always listen to you, always excellent with your pet and just a really caring, nurturing environment. I tried many vets before this practice, and hit the jack pot here! My pet is very well cared for here and most importantly I trust them! Highly recommend this practice.
Always the most friendly staff, my dog loves coming to see everyone here!

They talked me into an operation for my dog which turned out to be totally unnecessary. Ran up a bill of £2000 which the insurance wouldn’t then cover due to previous notes. Feels like they scammed me.
will not go back
All round good experience.
They always do their job very well and professionally
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
The staff are BRILLIANT!!! Caring and supportive.
Online account doesn’t work properly and had to chase for my cats 6 month check up.as well as their notes from first appointment
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

Medivet in Parson's Green - absolutely wonderful! Special shout of to Lynn :)

The team is incredibly helpful, professional, and always goes above and beyond to provide the best care. They are warm, attentive, and truly dedicated to the well-being of every pet.

I couldn’t ask for a better experience—highly recommend!

Thank you to the entire team for being so amazing—you make such a difference, and we’re so grateful to have you looking after our clients for pet travel documents
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
They are the BEST! Always makes you feel safe for your loved ones. Very professional and very friendly and warm as well.
Caring and informative. In good hands

We love the practice, everyone is friendly and helpful.
Big thanks to Gabi
Rushed home to get to the vets only to find it’s closed despite operating hours on google and entrance saying otherwise. Unacceptable. Update your operating hours or get better staff
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

** updated: after posting this review my next experience at the vets was much better! The vet I had was very friendly and good with Olive (changing my review from 2 to 4 stars)

I feel very disappointed after my experience this morning, which is such a shame as I had high hopes after reading the reviews.

I recently got a puppy and rang up to book a first check-up and her second vaccinations. The women I booked with on the phone (on Tuesday) was so lovely and enthusiastic, so I was pleased to think there would be great service here and was excited to take little Olive in!

However, unfortunately this morning I found the vet to be quite rushed and a bit brash with me- she didn't take the time to talk through any concerns with me or allow me to ask questions, so I left feeling quite confused and stressed. I'm only leaving this review as I'd like the staff to consider that for first time dog owners, the first check up can be worrying for us and that more compassion/care would be appreciated.

Gabi Milea has looked after my dog ever since I got her as I absolutly trust him to look after her best interests.  Previously he had looked after my cat.

Recently Gabi neutered my dog using keyhole surgery and did an excellent job.  My dog recovered very quickly and was back to playing and running around within 2 days.   The recovery time was very quick and she wasn't traumatised by the experience at all...indeed she couldn't wait to go back and see Gabi for her POC as evidenced by her wagging tail and enthusiastic happiness once she entered the vets and saw Gabi again.

Gabi is professional, extremely knowledgeable and trustworthy.  In short, he is an excellent vet who my dog is always pleased to see.  He always takes time to greet my dog and give treats. He patiently explains any procedures together with any associated risks and is more than willing to answer my questions. All the nurses and staff are excellent..very friendly and professional.  I feel very privileged and lucky to have Medivet Parsons Green looking after my dog.
Gabi the vet is excellent we wouldn't take our dogs anywhere else. Bella and Roxie are well looked after by his team. Polite helpful receptionists and all round a great team
The team at Parson’s Green Medivet are brilliant. They always take great care of my dog, explaining things in an easy to get way and showing incredible attention to detail and very attentive.
